session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Buy Climax, Then Small Pullback Bear Trend' (6/28, 'Jul' edge marker). Reading: a 9-bar bull breakout into the open topped with an exhaustive buy climax at 5588 that failed (red dotted 5583.5 LH), the bear breakout from the climax sold to 5565 and then trended down all day with shallow pullbacks ('Small pullback bear trend' printed mid-chart); a wedge bottom at the 10:00 lows failed at the 10:35 retest, and the late leg produced an exhaustive sell climax / sell vacuum down to the exact measured move target (orange dotted 5509.5) derived from the height of the opening buy climax, followed by tight chop into the close ~5530.
